description: dsh hook bridge: config + scripts generated per project, and the platform-detection fix that makes them identify the session
changelog:
**DSH hook bridge (new):** `trellis init/update --dsh` now writes `.dsh/hooks.json` plus the shared hook scripts under `.dsh/hooks/`, so a DSH project can drive SessionStart, per-turn workflow-state, path-scoped spec injection, and sub-agent context through hooks.

**One manual step is required, and Trellis cannot do it for you.** DSH has no hook system of its own; it reaches these scripts through the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-hooks-claude-code` bridge, which is mounted once per machine in `$DSH_HOME/cordis.patch.yml` — a profile-level file outside any project. Add the row documented in `.dsh/DSH.md` (section "Hooks: mount the bridge once") and restart `dsh web`. Notes: `configPath` must be absolute, the bridge holds ONE `configPath` per process (so a second DSH project needs its own mount), and on Windows `run-python-hook.cjs` may need `TRELLIS_PYTHON` pinned or the hook cannot find a Python 3.

**Fixed — DSH sessions resolved the wrong task identity.** The bridge spawns hooks with no `DSH_*` namespace but does set `CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR`, which the shared platform detector treats as a Claude Code alias. DSH events were therefore identified as `claude_<id>` while `task.py start` (run in a DSH shell that DOES export `DSH_SESSION_ID`) wrote `dsh_<id>`. The keys never matched, so every turn reported `no_task` even with a live task pointer on disk. Detection now keys off the `.dsh` script path, before any environment alias. This affected `session-start.py`, `inject-workflow-state.py`, and `inject-subagent-context.py` (the last also needed it ordered before its `SubagentStart`→codex shortcut). Existing DSH projects receive the fixed scripts automatically through this update.
notes: No `--migrate` required. After updating, DSH hook injection needs the one-time bridge mount described above; until it is mounted the project files are inert and behaviour is unchanged. If your specs should participate in path-scoped injection, their frontmatter must declare a non-empty `paths:` list — a spec tree without it stays inert no matter how the hooks are mounted.
